programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Deciding to crack open a bottle of scotch and hunker down for the night, Castle's assistant and daughter are disturbed by a noise outside, alarmed by an axe splintering the door, and finally terrified when a crazed man walks in. Before Alexis can retrieve her father's gun, the man drops to the floor, dead. The next day, Lanie's autopsy reveals that the man was covered in religious scriptures, drawn in ink all over his body. He died of stab wounds, the attacker having left a clawlike gash with traces of sulphur. Castle is convinced the killer must be a demon. The case becomes more demonic still when Castle realises the dead man was trying to reach a safe in his office, that has remained unopened since Castle took on the building. After it is cracked open, an artefact known as the Angel Blade is discovered, a weapon that can kill the son of the devil. But who was the intended target?

As the team evolves together, the Behavioral Analysis Unit continues its dedication to using their expertise to pinpoint predators' motivations and identify their emotional triggers in the attempt to stop them. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: LokSat is the dirty drug-running and money laundering operation with tentacles that spread to the highest levels of the CIA, and even as far as Senator William Bracken—the currently jailed politician responsible for Beckett's mother's murder. Castle and Beckett have a lead that they believe will allow them to bring down LokSat once and for all. They are trailing a lawyer named Caleb Brown, who they believe is carrying a memory stick packed with incriminating information, and is about to make contact with a high-ranking LokSat operative. They lie in wait near the rendezvous as "Caleb" comes into view. Then a call comes through from Lanie. She has identified the burned remains of a body found in the locked boot of a torched car— it is Caleb. Castle and Beckett have been trapped. LokSat seem to be holding all the aces. But is there a joker in the pack who can out-trump them?

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Deciding to crack open a bottle of scotch and hunker down for the night, Castle's assistant and daughter are disturbed by a noise outside, alarmed by an axe splintering the door, and finally terrified when a crazed man walks in. Before Alexis can retrieve her father's gun, the man drops to the floor, dead. The next day, Lanie's autopsy reveals that the man was covered in religious scriptures, drawn in ink all over his body. He died of stab wounds, the attacker having left a clawlike gash with traces of sulphur. Castle is convinced the killer must be a demon. The case becomes more demonic still when Castle realises the dead man was trying to reach a safe in his office, that has remained unopened since Castle took on the building. After it is cracked open, an artefact known as the Angel Blade is discovered, a weapon that can kill the son of the devil. But who was the intended target?

programme.title: Bones

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: When astronomers detect a transmission from another galaxy, it is definitive proof of intelligent extra-terrestrial life. The world's population waits for further contact with bated breath. They do not have to wait long. Within days, mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating attack; pockets of humanity are left in an eerily deserted world. As aliens hunt and kill those left alive, the survivors ask a burning question – who are these attackers and why are they hell-bent on our destruction? Emotional, cinematic and rooted in character, it is a unique marriage of human drama and the best science fiction. This is a story of ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances - but they are more than just victims in a brutal war. For, as we will come to realize, the aliens' savage attack on earth is not arbitrary: its seeds are being sown before our very eyes.

programme.title: Solar Opposites
programme.desc: How would Earth look to alien settlers? Awesome or awful? Well that's the contrasting opinions of an alien family in this animated American sitcom. A year ago, the alien family fled the destruction of their planet Shlorp and crashed on Earth, beginning a new life in foreign surroundings, where they must adjust to the idiosyncrasies of the human world. The family is made up of partners Korvo and Terry, and their child-replicants Yumyulack and Jesse. The show was created by Justin Roiland (Rick and Morty) and Mike McMahan, with voices provided by Roiland, Thomas Middleditch, Sean Giambrone, and Mary Mack, among others.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: Genius super villain M.O.D.O.K. spends his time juggling his evil scientific empire, AIM, and his responsibilities as a husband and father to two teens. Due to financial strains, M.O.D.O.K. is sweet-talked into selling AIM to tech giant GRUMBL. Upon realizing his mistake, M.O.D.O.K. goes to super villainous lengths to get his company back, even going as far as mind-controlling his own wife. He ultimately fails to save AIM, and his lifelong obsession with conquering the world leaves his wife, Jodie, with only one option ― divorce.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: In a bid to save his marriage, M.O.D.O.K. takes Jodie back in time to a concert they missed when they were in college. During a detour to kill the child-version of his GRUMBL boss, M.O.D.O.K. and Jodie are attacked by college-aged M.O.D.O.K., who accidentally absorbs their time crystals, stranding them in 2002. The couple reconciles but is stuck in the past until they catch up to the present. Once in the present, they prevent themselves from ever going to the past in the first place, erasing their entire adventure from the timeline.

These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives. The show draws from real-life, high-pressure experiences of first responders who regularly face heart-stopping situations that are often unpredictable, intense and uplifting at the same time.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Deciding to crack open a bottle of scotch and hunker down for the night, Castle's assistant and daughter are disturbed by a noise outside, alarmed by an axe splintering the door, and finally terrified when a crazed man walks in. Before Alexis can retrieve her father's gun, the man drops to the floor, dead. The next day, Lanie's autopsy reveals that the man was covered in religious scriptures, drawn in ink all over his body. He died of stab wounds, the attacker having left a clawlike gash with traces of sulphur. Castle is convinced the killer must be a demon. The case becomes more demonic still when Castle realises the dead man was trying to reach a safe in his office, that has remained unopened since Castle took on the building. After it is cracked open, an artefact known as the Angel Blade is discovered, a weapon that can kill the son of the devil. But who was the intended target?

programme.title: Bones

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: LokSat is the dirty drug-running and money laundering operation with tentacles that spread to the highest levels of the CIA, and even as far as Senator William Bracken—the currently jailed politician responsible for Beckett's mother's murder. Castle and Beckett have a lead that they believe will allow them to bring down LokSat once and for all. They are trailing a lawyer named Caleb Brown, who they believe is carrying a memory stick packed with incriminating information, and is about to make contact with a high-ranking LokSat operative. They lie in wait near the rendezvous as "Caleb" comes into view. Then a call comes through from Lanie. She has identified the burned remains of a body found in the locked boot of a torched car— it is Caleb. Castle and Beckett have been trapped. LokSat seem to be holding all the aces. But is there a joker in the pack who can out-trump them?

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan is a highly skilled forensic anthropologist who works at the Jeffersonian Institute and writes novels as a sideline. When the standard methods of identifying a body are deemed useless--when the remains are so badly decomposed, burned or destroyed that CSI gives up-- law enforcement calls in Brennan for her uncanny ability to read clues left behind in the victim's bones. Most law enforcement is unable to handle Brennan's intelligence, her drive for the truth, or the way she flings herself headlong into every investigation. FBI Special Agent Seeley Booth is the exception. A former Army sniper, Booth mistrusts science and scientists--the "squints," as he calls them, who pore over the physical evidence-- when it comes to solving crimes. But even he cannot deny that the combination of his people-smarts and Brennan's scientific acumen make them a formidable team.

programme.title: Castle

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: When astronomers detect a transmission from another galaxy, it is definitive proof of intelligent extra-terrestrial life. The world's population waits for further contact with bated breath. They do not have to wait long. Within days, mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating attack; pockets of humanity are left in an eerily deserted world. As aliens hunt and kill those left alive, the survivors ask a burning question – who are these attackers and why are they hell-bent on our destruction? Emotional, cinematic and rooted in character, it is a unique marriage of human drama and the best science fiction. This is a story of ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances - but they are more than just victims in a brutal war. For, as we will come to realize, the aliens' savage attack on earth is not arbitrary: its seeds are being sown before our very eyes.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: Genius super villain M.O.D.O.K. spends his time juggling his evil scientific empire, AIM, and his responsibilities as a husband and father to two teens. Due to financial strains, M.O.D.O.K. is sweet-talked into selling AIM to tech giant GRUMBL. Upon realizing his mistake, M.O.D.O.K. goes to super villainous lengths to get his company back, even going as far as mind-controlling his own wife. He ultimately fails to save AIM, and his lifelong obsession with conquering the world leaves his wife, Jodie, with only one option ― divorce.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K.
programme.desc: In a bid to save his marriage, M.O.D.O.K. takes Jodie back in time to a concert they missed when they were in college. During a detour to kill the child-version of his GRUMBL boss, M.O.D.O.K. and Jodie are attacked by college-aged M.O.D.O.K., who accidentally absorbs their time crystals, stranding them in 2002. The couple reconciles but is stuck in the past until they catch up to the present. Once in the present, they prevent themselves from ever going to the past in the first place, erasing their entire adventure from the timeline.

programme.title: Varenais Ričards
programme.desc: Ričards ir jauns zvirbulēns, kuru savā lokā pieņēmusi stārķu ģimene. Viņš pavada ziemu Āfrikas ziemeļos, taču ir pienācis laiks atgriezties mājās. Ričards vēlas vadīt gājputnu kāsi, bet šim uzdevumam tiek izraudzīts viņa pusbrālis Makss. Jaunais putnēns jūtas aizvainots, taču drīz sākas vētrains piedzīvojums. programme.title: Roboti
programme.desc: Arī pasaulē, kurā mīt tikai mehāniskas būtnes, ir vajadzīgi izgudrotāji. programme.title: Vīri melnā: Globālie draudi
programme.desc: Slepenās organizācijas "Vīri melnā" jaunākā aģente M pēc neparastas tikšanās ar citplanētiešiem nonāk Londonā, kur pieredzējušā aģenta H vadībā iesaistās bīstamā izmeklēšanā. Kad divi formas mainīt spējīgi starpgalaktiski slepkavas nogalina citplanētiešu aristokrātu, atklājas, ka uz Zemes paslēpts masu iznīcināšanas ierocis, kas var apdraudēt visu planētu. Aģentiem jādara viss iespējamais, lai to atrastu un nepieļautu katastrofu. Tomēr izmeklēšanu sarežģī aizdomas un nodevības ēna, kas pārņem arī pašu organizāciju. Vai starp "Vīriem melnā" ir nodevējs, kurš strādā ienaidnieka labā?

programme.title: Nav izejas
programme.desc: Jaunā studente Dārbija Torna mēģina sakārtot savu dzīvi rehabilitācijas klīnikā, līdz uzzina, ka viņas māte atrodas slimnīcā kritiskā stāvoklī. Nerēķinoties ar briesmām un tuvojošos sniega vētru, Dārbija bēg no klīnikas, lai dotos pie mātes. Daba izrādās stiprāka, un meitene ir spiesta nakts vidū meklēt patvērumu nomaļā lielceļa pieturvietā, kur sastop četrus svešiniekus: Sendiju, Edu, Ešu un Larsu. Gaisotne ir saspīlēta, tomēr Dārbijai šķiet, ka ļaunākais šajā naktī ir neparedzētā aizkavēšanās. Taču, mēģinot stāvvietā "noķert" mobilo sakaru zonu, Dārbija kādas automašīnas bagāžniekā nejauši pamana nolaupītu meiteni. Palīdzību izsaukt nav iespējams, ceļi ir aizputināti, un viņa saprot - viens no četriem cilvēkiem, ar kuriem viņa tikko malkoja kafiju un spēlēja kārtis, ir bīstams noziedznieks. Dārbija apņemas glābt mazo meiteni, neapjaušot, ka šī nakts pārvērtīsies īstā murgā.

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. programme.title: EuroLeague. Real Madrid - Zalgiris Kaunas
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Futbols: Bundesliga. Werder Bremen - Hamburg
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Futbols: LaLiga. Real Madrid - Celta
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Olympiacos - Hapoel TA
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Barnwood Builders
programme.desc: Barnwood Builders is an American documentary TV series following a team of builders that magically turn historic barns and log cabins into modern houses. Mark Bowe is the owner West Virginia company, he buys old barns and log cabins in order to reuse the hand-hewn logs. His professional team specializes in the reclamation and restoration of pioneer era structures in the eastern United States. The pioneers of modern days give pioneer cabins and barns a new life, they save barns with history and introduce the viewers to the incredible structures and american icons of building work.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: For generations, people have been gathering around the table to experience the traditional recipes of America's most popular ethnic cuisine – Italian food. Have you ever met anyone who hasn't tried pasta? Probably not since Americans eat over 2 billion pounds of it each year. But pasta's just a part of our big Italian family dinner. Host Bobby Bognar travels from coast to coast in search of what makes this dinner so special. He'll trawl the waters off North Carolina and crawl the forests of New Mexico for the ingredients in our pasta sauces. In New York, he'll learn the secret behind pasta's many shapes. Then he'll press some California grapes and learn how one type of bacteria makes both vinegar and wine. And when it's time for dessert, Bobby goes from New Jersey, where he learns the difference between gelato and ice cream, all the way to Costa Rica for an after-dinner caffeine boost. So pull up a chair, grab a plate and help yourself.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: This episode investigates a stage collapse at the Indiana State Fair that leaves seven concertgoers dead. Is a gas leak to blame for an explosion in New York City that levels two buildings and kills eight people in their homes? Disaster strikes on an airliner at 36,000 feet as a gaping hole suddenly rips open midflight. Engineers in Japan scramble to save the lives of millions as an epic radioactive release looms. And, how could a train crossing be the site of not one, but two disastrous auto collisions in a single year?

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: In the climax of the investigation, the head of the team leads a search of two marshes in the heart of Bogota that are listed in the declassified FBI files as being the location of a submerged plane that transported Hitler to the area. programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

Are we getting close to a rediscovery--and reactivation--of the Ark? And if so, will the Ark of the Covenant reveal a long, lost connection to our extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: For generations, people have been gathering around the table to experience the traditional recipes of America's most popular ethnic cuisine – Italian food. Have you ever met anyone who hasn't tried pasta? Probably not since Americans eat over 2 billion pounds of it each year. But pasta's just a part of our big Italian family dinner. Host Bobby Bognar travels from coast to coast in search of what makes this dinner so special. He'll trawl the waters off North Carolina and crawl the forests of New Mexico for the ingredients in our pasta sauces. In New York, he'll learn the secret behind pasta's many shapes. Then he'll press some California grapes and learn how one type of bacteria makes both vinegar and wine. And when it's time for dessert, Bobby goes from New Jersey, where he learns the difference between gelato and ice cream, all the way to Costa Rica for an after-dinner caffeine boost. So pull up a chair, grab a plate and help yourself.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: This episode investigates a stage collapse at the Indiana State Fair that leaves seven concertgoers dead. Is a gas leak to blame for an explosion in New York City that levels two buildings and kills eight people in their homes? Disaster strikes on an airliner at 36,000 feet as a gaping hole suddenly rips open midflight. Engineers in Japan scramble to save the lives of millions as an epic radioactive release looms. And, how could a train crossing be the site of not one, but two disastrous auto collisions in a single year?

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: In the climax of the investigation, the head of the team leads a search of two marshes in the heart of Bogota that are listed in the declassified FBI files as being the location of a submerged plane that transported Hitler to the area. Using historical maps and cutting edge technology the team corroborates information from the FBI file and finds evidence of a suspicious object buried deep in the mud of a marsh matching the description within the files, which could be a plane!

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Across ancient civilizations, the world's mountains were viewed as the sacred home to all-powerful gods. Why would so many different cultures share this belief that mountains had a connection to otherworldly beings? The Greeks believed their most powerful gods, the Olympians, waged an epic war for control of the universe from Mt. Olympus. Ruins of a 4000-year-old observatory discovered on a mountain in Macedonia reveal that the ancients tracked celestial movements from on high with remarkable precision. And in Peru, the descendants of the Incans continue an ancient pilgrimage tradition in order to commune with mountain spirits known as Apu. Could these gods have been extraterrestrials? programme.title: Warriors

Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler

In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Across ancient civilizations, the world's mountains were viewed as the sacred home to all-powerful gods. Why would so many different cultures share this belief that mountains had a connection to otherworldly beings? The Greeks believed their most powerful gods, the Olympians, waged an epic war for control of the universe from Mt. Olympus. Ruins of a 4000-year-old observatory discovered on a mountain in Macedonia reveal that the ancients tracked celestial movements from on high with remarkable precision. And in Peru, the descendants of the Incans continue an ancient pilgrimage tradition in order to commune with mountain spirits known as Apu. Could these gods have been extraterrestrials? Did they use remote mountain peaks to interact with early man? Might this explain why humans have been drawn to mountains for thousands of years?

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: Today, New York is the biggest city in the country... but it's got some dark secrets in its past. It was founded by covert groups, overrun with gangs and mob bosses, and ruled by secret societies. This is the true foundation of the city that never sleeps, and host Don Wildman is headed deep beneath the skyscrapers, taxicabs and street vendors into a New York that few have ever seen before. From a hidden Freemason tunnel and secret world of the Sandhogs, to mobster hideaways and gang escape routes, we're uncovering the secret societies that built New York--from the underground up.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Strange rock carvings from 8,000 B.C. Unexplained sightings in the new world. And a frightening anomaly plaguing the American West. Is there more to America's past than is found in our history books? Could the mysterious stories and relics found throughout the United States be evidence of extraterrestrial contact in the distant past? In 1909, the Phoenix Gazette reported the finding of a strange man-made cave filled with ancient objects and mummies. Could there be a connection between the mysterious cave and the legend of Native American ancestors called "Star Beings?" Strange lights and unexplained weather anomalies were documented throughout colonial America. Is there evidence that early American settlers had close encounters with extraterrestrial entities? Could UFO sightings and reports of alien contact be part of America's untold history?

programme.title: When Big Things Go Wrong
programme.desc: Modern technology allows us to build incredible structures like giant tankers, mammoth skyscrapers and colossal bridges. But, with enormous size comes enormous risk, and when big things go wrong, they go really wrong. The HISTORY Channel's new series examines the catastrophic result of some of the world's worst engineering disasters caught on tape. Each episode breaks down shocking footage from collapses and collisions to reveal the shocking answers to the question, what happened? Woven together through innovative graphics, eyewitness accounts and expert knowledge, the series unravels the mystery behind these destructive moments and their lasting worldwide impact.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: Why did a 72 oil-car runaway train crash, killing 47 people and leveling half a town? Was it the brakes? Also, can engineers do anything to fix a gaping sinkhole at the National Corvette Museum, so car enthusiasts can safely return? And, what caused the Minneapolis Metrodome's iconic roof to collapse? Was it an engineering flaw or Mother Nature? Football fans want to know. Then, as 33 Chilean miners await their ultimate fate, trapped almost a half mile underground, mine drilling engineers scramble to dig a hole big enough to rescue them. Can a special drill make it though through earth harder than granite? And finally, JetBlue flight 194 started out like any other for 149 passengers. But just minutes into the journey, the airplane is almost crippled by a sudden hydraulic failure.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes

programme.title: House of Horrors: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Documentary series that tells the terrifying stories of people who were kidnapped and lived to tell their stories. Each episode reveals their awful experience from the moment of the abduction to the hours, days or months of captivity, right to the escape and recovery. Some of the cases that series tackles is abduction of the 13-year old Alicia Kozakiewicz by Scott Tyree, who had approached her in an internet chat room, the case of Marc Schiller, who was ambushed by thugs in broad daylight, the case of Teka Adams, pregnant woman who was abducted by Veronica Deramous, who had claimed to be a caseworker, case of Karen Kummerer, who was captured by her ex-boyfriend and taken on a terrifying, multi-state road trip in her own car, and many other dreadful stories.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: Border Control Poland
programme.desc: A sniffer dog strikes in Medyka. The four-legged friend sniffed out tobacco products hidden in a minibus. Customs officials found 111 packs of cigarettes in the car. The driver of the van faces a fine as well as an entry ban to the European Union. The Polish border guards also struck gold when checking a car in Korczowa. And employees of the tax authorities are examining four arcades in Warsaw. During the raids, the investigators are accompanied by an armed special unit.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: June 19, 2017: When a former crime reporter for the Tampa Tribune, David A. Sommer of Safety Harbor, Florida, is found brutally murdered inside his own home, law enforcement investigators take a look at David's estranged wife Jeannie Sommer and also David's neighbors. Jeannie is cleared of any wrongdoing very quickly. Of all the neighbors, the homicide investigators zero in on Michael Harbaugh, who was out of prison on parole and had the opportunity to commit the crime. Michael makes the mistake of incriminating himself during his jailhouse phone calls. In the end, Michael is charged with Sommer's murder, and takes a plea deal for 15 years in prison. He was also charged with conspiracy to commit murder when he was overheard attempting to arrange a murder-for-hire from behind jail walls, to eliminate a witness who was going to testify against him on the David Sommer case.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: Yulee, Florida, May 13, 2018: When a young mother of three children, Joleen Cummings, age 34, vanishes on Mother's Day, which also happens to fall on her birthday this year, police race to find her. The search grips the entire community, but no one is ready for what the search will uncover -- a female suspect who is guilty of twenty years of lies and violence. Joleen's husband, Jason Cummings, with whom she had separated, is cleared of any wrongdoing by the detectives. Likewise, her sometimes-violent boyfriend Jason Gee is also cleared. Joleen was a hair stylist at Tangles Hair Salon. In the end, Joleen's co-worker, Jennifer Marie Sybert, whose "real" name turned out to be Kimberly Lee Kessler, is arrested for the murder. Kim Kessler is caught on surveillance camera disposing of evidence that implicates her, in addition to blood evidence left in the Tangles Salon and scratches on her face. Kimberly Kessler was convicted and sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Кухня
programme.desc: "Во все времена еда была рядом с людьми. Она искушает, вдохновляет, восхищает, отвращает. Но человек не может без еды, а значит тот, кто создает еду, может управлять миром…". Так думал Максим Лавров, когда шел осуществлять свою мечту — устраиваться поваром в один из самых дорогих ресторанов столицы. Мечта сбылась, вот только на деле все вышло не так вкусно. Шеф-повар ресторана Виктор Баринов — настоящая звезда гастрономического бомонда, знающая как угодить взыскательной публике. Оборотная сторона этого идеального образа — злоупотребление алкоголем, страсть к азартным играм и невыносимый характер. В гневе Баринов страшен, в загуле — неукротим. Арт-директор Виктория Гончарова — настоящая снежная королева, карьеристка с ледяным сердцем, однако именно с ней Макс проводит ночь до того, как пойти на новую работу. А вся команда поваров только и ждет промашки новичка, чтобы от души посмеяться.

programme.title: Кухня
programme.desc: В 6 сезоне сериала "Кухня" будут раскрыты все карты. Виктор Баринов будет бороться за звезду Мишлен и столкнется с немалыми трудностями на пути к своей мечте. Елена Павловна решится поменять профессию, что обернется для нее семейными проблемами. В ресторан вернется Вика. Кате предстоит принять самое сложное решение в ее жизни. Су-шефа Леву ждет множество трудностей на работе, а также развитие отношений с Гулей. Нагиева ждут испытания на личном фронте, кроме того, нелегко ему придется и в освоении новой профессии. Как сложатся судьбы героев? Смогут ли они преодолеть все трудности и сделать правильный выбор?

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Проект Ирины Хангошвили о культуре, истории и традициях различных стран мира. Ведущий - Зураб Двали - путешествует и приглашает зрителей пройтись вместе с ним по красивым местам, увидеть достопримечательности, полюбоваться природой и познакомиться с интересными людьми. Всюду гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Зрители сначала узнают интересные исторические факты о самых известных или забытых регионах различных стран, и затем останавливаются на кулинарных традициях - готовят несколько блюд с гостями программы.

programme.title: Балтия неделя
programme.desc: "Я многим режиссерам говорю, что музыка в фильме - как душа. Ты ее в фильме не видишь, но она там живет". Карлис Аузанс - один из самых цитируемых в мировой киноиндустрии латвийских композиторов. Он автор музыки к целому ряду фильмов, которые завоевали престижные международные награды.

programme.title: Столичная штучка
programme.desc: Марина — менеджер в агропромышленной компании, она привыкла к городскому ритму, каблукам и маникюру. Но однажды её отправляют руководить установкой нового доильного аппарата в отдаленный район Тамбовской глубинки. Новая должность переворачивает привычный мир героини: отныне она живет в гостевом доме с баней, а окружают её простые односельчане и самые настоящие коровы. И теперь главная её проблема — убедить местных жителей, что "инновации" в области дойки им вообще нужны. А для начала Марине придется расположить к себе мастера на все руки Валеру, который пользуется авторитетом у простых работяг. Героине предстоит не только научиться находить общий язык с ними, но еще пройти путь от "столичной штучки" к себе настоящей.

Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Ча-ча-ча
programme.desc: Екатерина в разводе, и с помощью танцев хочет отвлечься, чтобы пережить предстоящий переезд в Англию дочери и внука, ставших смыслом ее жизни. Кассирша Марина мечтает выйти замуж и родить ребенка. А финансист Рита пришла в танцевальный зал по совету психолога, чтобы спасти свой брак. Девушки отправляются учиться танцевать ча-ча-ча к лучезарному и неотразимому преподавателю Александру. Только мало кто знает, что и у Александра в жизни тоже не все так празднично, как кажется на первый взгляд.

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: Всегда ли родовое гнездо является безопасным местом, хранящим тепло и уют домашнего очага? Эти женщины так не считают. Они уверены в том, что их собственный дом расправляется с членами этой семьи. Что скажут на это экстрасенсы? Подтвердят ли они эту страшную информацию? Ясновидящим придётся распутать и ещё одно мистическое дело - смерть молодого человека. Сложность ситуации заключается в том, что полиция, вроде бы, озвучила имя виновного, но что скажут на это экстрасенсы? У трёх сестёр явные проблемы в личной жизни. Они теряют мужей одного за другим - те либо умирают, либо бросают их ради других женщин.

programme.title: Вскрытие покажет
programme.desc: Случайные люди не задерживаются на работе в криминальном бюро, ведь каждый день приходится иметь дело со смертью и горем людей. Олег Гончар — профессионал в розыскной деятельности, опытный оперативник. Его коллега, судмедэксперт Инга Вилкас, устроилась в бюро недавно и пока не очень хорошо уживается с Олегом из-за своего резкого и прямолинейного характера. Личная жизнь у обоих не складывается, работа отнимает много времени, накладывая при этом свой отпечаток на их характеры. Но, проработав вместе некоторое время, Олег и Инга замечают, что деловое общение постепенно превращается в нечто большее.

programme.title: Кухня
programme.desc: "Во все времена еда была рядом с людьми. Она искушает, вдохновляет, восхищает, отвращает. Но человек не может без еды, а значит тот, кто создает еду, может управлять миром…". Так думал Максим Лавров, когда шел осуществлять свою мечту — устраиваться поваром в один из самых дорогих ресторанов столицы. Мечта сбылась, вот только на деле все вышло не так вкусно. Шеф-повар ресторана Виктор Баринов — настоящая звезда гастрономического бомонда, знающая как угодить взыскательной публике. Оборотная сторона этого идеального образа — злоупотребление алкоголем, страсть к азартным играм и невыносимый характер. В гневе Баринов страшен, в загуле — неукротим. Арт-директор Виктория Гончарова — настоящая снежная королева, карьеристка с ледяным сердцем, однако именно с ней Макс проводит ночь до того, как пойти на новую работу. А вся команда поваров только и ждет промашки новичка, чтобы от души посмеяться.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Кухня
programme.desc: "Во все времена еда была рядом с людьми. Она искушает, вдохновляет, восхищает, отвращает. Но человек не может без еды, а значит тот, кто создает еду, может управлять миром…". Так думал Максим Лавров, когда шел осуществлять свою мечту — устраиваться поваром в один из самых дорогих ресторанов столицы. Мечта сбылась, вот только на деле все вышло не так вкусно. Шеф-повар ресторана Виктор Баринов — настоящая звезда гастрономического бомонда, знающая как угодить взыскательной публике. Оборотная сторона этого идеального образа — злоупотребление алкоголем, страсть к азартным играм и невыносимый характер. В гневе Баринов страшен, в загуле — неукротим. Арт-директор Виктория Гончарова — настоящая снежная королева, карьеристка с ледяным сердцем, однако именно с ней Макс проводит ночь до того, как пойти на новую работу. А вся команда поваров только и ждет промашки новичка, чтобы от души посмеяться.

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Чиатура — некогда флагман СССР по добыче марганцевой руды. Сегодня город напоминает декорации к мистическому фильму: здесь немало заброшенных жилых домов, скульптур в духе соцреализма, покинутых шахтерских зданий. Тем не менее, Чиатура стал популярен среди любителей экстремального туризма, особенно всех впечатляют прогулки на старых вагончиках по подвесным канатным дорогам, которые до сих пор используются как общественный транспорт. Как живут и что думают о своих перспективах сами чиатурцы?

programme.title: Балтия неделя
programme.desc: Житель Риги, бывший летчик "большой гражданской авиации" Виктор Талпа еще в советские времена организовал и возглавил рижский Клуб юных летчиков. Здесь подросткам давали летную профессию - моторист самолета АН-2. Чтобы они учились не по картинкам, Виктор Талпа стал собирать для самолеты.

programme.title: Ча-ча-ча
programme.desc: Екатерина в разводе, и с помощью танцев хочет отвлечься, чтобы пережить предстоящий переезд в Англию дочери и внука, ставших смыслом ее жизни. Кассирша Марина мечтает выйти замуж и родить ребенка. А финансист Рита пришла в танцевальный зал по совету психолога, чтобы спасти свой брак. Девушки отправляются учиться танцевать ча-ча-ча к лучезарному и неотразимому преподавателю Александру. Только мало кто знает, что и у Александра в жизни тоже не все так празднично, как кажется на первый взгляд.

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Степногорск - город, расположенный в степях северного Казахстана. Долгое время он не обозначался даже на самых подробных картах СССР, имея закрытый статус. В советское время тут производили бактериологическое оружие (боевой штамм сибирской язвы). Для этого были оборудованы специальные помещения под землей, на глубине 90 метров. По старой привычке люди боятся говорить об этом, как будто ощущая себя соучастниками тех страшных экспериментов.

programme.title: Французская кулинария
programme.desc: После многочисленных любовных неудач француженка Луиза встречает в Париже мужчину своей мечты - русского красавца Виктора. Но счастье Луизы оказывается недолгим. Виктор вынужден вернуться в Россию. Ему предложили должность арт-директора в новом ресторане французской кухни в провинциальном Таганроге. Девушка отправляется в Россию искать Виктора. Однако, приехав в Таганрог, Луиза узнает, что у нее есть соперница - владелица ресторана Юля, в прошлом - королева красоты "Мисс Таганрог 2007". Решив вернуть Виктора во что бы то ни стало, Луиза выдает себя за шеф-повара французской кухни и устраивается работать в ресторан Юли. Проблема только в том, что Луиза вообще не умеет готовить…

Однако, приехав в Таганрог, Луиза узнает, что у нее есть соперница - владелица ресторана Юля, в прошлом - королева красоты "Мисс Таганрог 2007". Решив вернуть Виктора во что бы то ни стало, Луиза выдает себя за шеф-повара французской кухни и устраивается работать в ресторан Юли. Проблема только в том, что Луиза вообще не умеет готовить…

programme.title: Что же получается
programme.desc: Гражданские войны в Боснии и Герцеговине и Хорватии закончились в 1995 году - почти 30 лет тому назад. Но здесь до сих пор практически ежедневно звучат взрывы. "Мину очень легко и дешево произвести и очень сложно ликвидировать. Вот почему гуманитарное разминирование так дорого стоит", - говорят саперы из MAG, международной неправительственной организации, которая очищает от мин здешние леса и поля. Журналисты проекта Настоящего Времени "Что же получается" увидели своими глазами, как работают саперы, и расспросили их о том, как идет поиск мин - от анализа хода военных конфликтов, поиска карт и разговора с местными жителями до выхода в поле с собакой и металлоискателем.

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. programme.title: Гуляй, Вася!
programme.desc: Бедный Митя влип по полной: случайно сделал предложение, а отец девушки, как будто только этого и ждал - тут же назначил дату свадьбы. Все бы ничего, да только Митя… уже женат! Он возвращается в свой город, чтобы экстренно развестись. Но Василиса (или просто Вася), с которой они давно не живут, - циничная стерва, и за развод придется побороться. Простейший способ ускорить процесс - предъявить первую попавшуюся "невесту". Кто же знал, что у нее имеется настоящий жених, местный качок... Окончательно все запутывается, когда разруливать ситуацию берутся бывшие одноклассники Мити - подкаблучник Паша и аферист Гарик.

programme.title: Я тоже хочу
programme.desc: Герои картины — музыкант, бандит, его друг Матвей со стариком-отцом и юная красотка едут на поиски Колокольни Счастья. По слухам, она находится где-то между Санкт-Петербургом и Угличем, неподалёку от заброшенной атомной электростанции. С людьми, попавшими в это место, происходит нечто мистическое, но далеко не все они исчезают. Каждый из пятерых надеется, что Колокольня "заберёт" именно его. Фильм-участник Международного кинофестиваля в Венеции.

But when forced to make a choice between loyalty to the pack and loyalty to Boy, friendship comes through and saves the day.

programme.title: Raven's Home
programme.desc: Best friends Raven and Chelsea are together again and raising their three children under one roof! Raven's 11-year-old twins Booker and Nia, and Chelsea's 9-year-old son Levi are navigating a chaotic but fun household that often includes the twin's best friend and neighbor Tess. Raven still catches glimpses of the future, but she's not the only one in the family who does – Booker has the same ability. While the future may not always be crystal clear, no matter the situation, they figure everything out together as one big happy family.

programme.title: Robocar Poli
programme.desc: The super, transforming Robocar rescue team is here to rescue friend's in danger! The lively Brooms Town is surrounded by awe-inspiring mountains and is located near the ocean. It is where people and cars, each with unique personalities live. The town has it's share of small and big incidents. It is the super Robocar rescue team. The team comprise's Poli, the righteous leader and police car, Roi, the brave and loyal fire engine, Amber, the kind and smart ambulance, Helly, the witty helicopter, and Jene, the eccentric inventor and operator. This team shows up whenever there is a friend in need of help. They demonstrate great teamwork and wisdom to re'scue their friends. While watching how the Robocar rescue team help's others, children will learn rules that they should observe in daily life to stay safe. They learn the sense of happiness that one feel's from helping others and the importance of living in harmony with others.

programme.title: Metalions
programme.desc: While cleaning his house, eight-year-old Elon finds a summoning device and scooter left behind by his brilliant scientist grandfather. While riding the scooter and wearing the summoning device on his wrist he gets into a dangerous situation. Just then, the Archean necklace his grandfather left behind starts lighting up and summons an ancient Infinite Warrior (a Metalion) named Leo. Leo saves Elon from danger, and develops a liking for Elon. The newly reawakened Leo is appalled by the unruliness of humans and is saddened that Earth's energy had long been depleted. Leo explains to Elon how he's a Infinite Warrior and used to be his grandfather's friend. Leo asks Elon to help him find all the remaining Archean Stones to restore the Earth's energy. Elon designs a stone detector and uses it to begin his journey with Leo. The pair set off in search of the stones scattered around the world.

programme.title: Polly Pocket
programme.desc: Often told she is too little to do all the things she wants to do, Polly doesn't let this stand in her way and proves what every kid should know... that being little isn't a limitation. Instead, its her greatest strength! Inheriting a magic locket that allows her to shrink to only 4 inches tall, she discovers that no matter how small she is, she can still have big adventures and create a big difference for her and her best friends! Based on the famous Polly Pocket doll, this Canadian-American animation TV series features 26 episodes of big adventures, lots of imagination and even more fun!

programme.title: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
programme.desc: When the kids get hold of an old ice cream truck, they start their own smoothie business! But the town's lovable ice cream man - Uncle Bub - isn't happy to have competition. He sets out to sabotage our heroes and keep them from serving up their tasty treats. But when the family has had enough they decide to retaliate! It's a mad race for customers, but it ends with Uncle Bub revealing his motive - he needed to axe the competition so he could make money for his true love's operations. So our gang calls off the feud to help Uncle Bub!... without first asking just who or what his true love actually is.

programme.title: Robocar Poli
programme.desc: The super, transforming Robocar rescue team is here to rescue friend's in danger! The lively Brooms Town is surrounded by awe-inspiring mountains and is located near the ocean. It is where people and cars, each with unique personalities live. The town has it's share of small and big incidents. It is the super Robocar rescue team. The team comprise's Poli, the righteous leader and police car, Roi, the brave and loyal fire engine, Amber, the kind and smart ambulance, Helly, the witty helicopter, and Jene, the eccentric inventor and operator. This team shows up whenever there is a friend in need of help. They demonstrate great teamwork and wisdom to re'scue their friends. While watching how the Robocar rescue team help's others, children will learn rules that they should observe in daily life to stay safe. They learn the sense of happiness that one feel's from helping others and the importance of living in harmony with others.

programme.title: Metalions
programme.desc: While cleaning his house, eight-year-old Elon finds a summoning device and scooter left behind by his brilliant scientist grandfather. While riding the scooter and wearing the summoning device on his wrist he gets into a dangerous situation. Just then, the Archean necklace his grandfather left behind starts lighting up and summons an ancient Infinite Warrior (a Metalion) named Leo. Leo saves Elon from danger, and develops a liking for Elon. The newly reawakened Leo is appalled by the unruliness of humans and is saddened that Earth's energy had long been depleted. Leo explains to Elon how he's a Infinite Warrior and used to be his grandfather's friend. Leo asks Elon to help him find all the remaining Archean Stones to restore the Earth's energy. Elon designs a stone detector and uses it to begin his journey with Leo. The pair set off in search of the stones scattered around the world.

programme.title: Tomass un draugi
programme.desc: Lokomotīve vārdā Tomass un viņa motorizētie draugi allaž gatavi jauniem piedzīvojumiem. Lokomotīvēm ik dienu jāpaveic kāds darbiņš – jāpārvadā cilvēki, jāpārvieto palaidnīgie vagoni, jādodas palīgā aizstāt citas lokomotīves, kamēr tās remontā. Katras dienas beigās neizbēgami tiek iegūta kāda vērtīga atziņa par dzīvi.

programme.title: Oktonauti
programme.desc: Oktonauti ir astoņu drosmīgu dzīvnieku komanda, kas dodas pretī zemūdens dziļumiem, lai bezbailīgi stātos pretī briesmām, iegūtu jaunus draugus un atklātu paslēptos jūras dzīļu dārgumus dažādās ekspedīcijās. Varonīgais oktonautu komandas kapteinis ir polārlācis Bārnakls. Viņš ir savādnieks, kurš mīl vadīt komandu, vienmēr pirmais dosies palīdzēt, bet brīvajā laikā viņam patīk spēlēt mūziku vai nodoties sapņainām pārdomām. Kaķis Kvazī ir negantnieks ar noslēpumainu pirāta pagātni. Viņš ceļo uz eksotiskām vietām, kuram patīk arī mierīga atpūta. Piemēram, zvilnēt vannā. Pingvīns Peso ir komandas mediķis. Viņš vislabāk zina, kā sasaitēt ievainojumus, līdzi sev nēsājot aptieciņu. Lai arī viņam ne sevišķi patīk briesmas, vajadzības gadījumā Peso dosies palīgā jebkuram oktonautam. Katras sērijas stāsts balstīts uz kādu zemūdens piedzīvojumu, atklājot dārgumu lādes, cīnoties ar haizivju baru vai glābjot kādu komandas biedru. Britu seriāla "Oktonauti" veidotāji ir kanādieši Vikija Vonga (Vicki Wong) un Maikls Mērfijs (Michael Murphy). Abi animatori darba procesā rūpīgi pētījuši zemūdens pasaules īpatnības, padarot animēto vidi pēc iespējas tuvinātu realitātei, taču nezaudējot noslēpuma un pasakainu piedzīvojumu auru. Seriāla veidošanā palīdzējusi arī jūras biologu komanda- speciālisti, kuri palīdzējuši tapt arī animācijas filmai "Meklējot Nemo".

programme.desc: Oktonauti ir astoņu drosmīgu dzīvnieku komanda, kas dodas pretī zemūdens dziļumiem, lai bezbailīgi stātos pretī briesmām, iegūtu jaunus draugus un atklātu paslēptos jūras dzīļu dārgumus dažādās ekspedīcijās. Varonīgais oktonautu komandas kapteinis ir polārlācis Bārnakls. Viņš ir savādnieks, kurš mīl vadīt komandu, vienmēr pirmais dosies palīdzēt, bet brīvajā laikā viņam patīk spēlēt mūziku vai nodoties sapņainām pārdomām. Kaķis Kvazī ir negantnieks ar noslēpumainu pirāta pagātni. Viņš ceļo uz eksotiskām vietām, kuram patīk arī mierīga atpūta. Piemēram, zvilnēt vannā. Pingvīns Peso ir komandas mediķis. Viņš vislabāk zina, kā sasaitēt ievainojumus, līdzi sev nēsājot aptieciņu. Lai arī viņam ne sevišķi patīk briesmas, vajadzības gadījumā Peso dosies palīgā jebkuram oktonautam. Katras sērijas stāsts balstīts uz kādu zemūdens piedzīvojumu, atklājot dārgumu lādes, cīnoties ar haizivju baru vai glābjot kādu komandas biedru. Britu seriāla "Oktonauti" veidotāji ir kanādieši Vikija Vonga (Vicki Wong) un Maikls Mērfijs (Michael Murphy). Abi animatori darba procesā rūpīgi pētījuši zemūdens pasaules īpatnības, padarot animēto vidi pēc iespējas tuvinātu realitātei, taču nezaudējot noslēpuma un pasakainu piedzīvojumu auru. Seriāla veidošanā palīdzējusi arī jūras biologu komanda- speciālisti, kuri palīdzējuši tapt arī animācijas filmai "Meklējot Nemo".

programme.title: Princese bruņiniece Nella

Lokomotīvēm ik dienu jāpaveic kāds darbiņš – jāpārvadā cilvēki, jāpārvieto palaidnīgie vagoni, jādodas palīgā aizstāt citas lokomotīves, kamēr tās remontā. programme.title: Uzmanību, gatavību, kosmosā!
programme.desc: Šons, kuram ir nerimstoša vēlme izzināt zinātnes faktus, un Sidnija, kurai patīk zinātniskā fantastika un iztēle, ir kaimiņi un labākie draugi. programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Pepa ir jauka, nekaunīga cūciņa, kas dzīvo ar savu mazo brāli Džordžu, kā arī sivēnu mammu un tēti. Pepas mīļākās nodarbes ir spēļu spēlēšana, pucēšanās, laiskošanās un rotaļāšanās dubļainās peļķēs. Viņas piedzīvojumi allaž beidzas laimīgi, skaļi un rukšķīgi skanot osies palīgā jebkuram oktonautam. Katras sērijas stāsts balstīts uz kādu zemūdens piedzīvojumu, atklājot dārgumu lādes, cīnoties ar haizivju baru vai glābjot kādu komandas biedru. Britu seriāla "Oktonauti" veidotāji ir kanādieši Vikija Vonga (Vicki Wong) un Maikls Mērfijs (Michael Murphy). Abi animatori darba procesā rūpīgi pētījuši zemūdens pasaules īpatnības, padarot animēto vidi pēc iespējas tuvinātu realitātei, taču nezaudējot noslēpuma un pasakainu piedzīvojumu auru. Seriāla veidošanā palīdzējusi arī jūras biologu komanda- speciālisti, kuri palīdzējuši tapt arī animācijas filmai "Meklējot Nemo".

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa

programme.title: Robopolicists Pollijs
programme.desc: Brūmstaunā, mazpilsētā ar varenu glābšanas komandu, allaž notiek negadījumi un nepatikšanas, piemēram, mašīna lietū noslīd no klints, kāda cita avarē, bērns tiek ieslēgts ugunsdzēsēju depo utt. Katrā sērijā glābšanas komanda kādu glābj.

programme.title: Runājošais Toms: Varoņi pēkšņi superīgi
programme.desc: Runājošais Toms un viņa draugi — Andžela, Bens un Henks atklāj noslēpumainu ierīci, kas viņiem piešķir pārsteidzošas spējas un padara viņus par ""Pēkšņi superīgiem""! Nu viņiem piemīt satriecošas spējas un dažādi noderīgi riki, un tie ir gatavi aizsargāt savu pilsētu no visa veida nelaimēm un neliešiem. Papildu palīdzību sniegs uzticamie draugi Runājošā Beka un Runājošā Džindžera. Diemžēl izrādās, ka supervaroņu dzīvei nav instrukcijas, un viņiem kopā būs jāatklāj savas patiesās spējas un jāglābj pasaule!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu namiņš
programme.desc: Ar nelielu maģiju un ikdienas Leļļu mājas piegādi izpētiet fantastisko Leļļu māju ar Gabiju un visiem viņas kaķu draugiem. Gabija ir pozitīva un apņēmīga 11 gadus veca meitene, kura pieņem trūkumus un pārvērš kļūdas izaugsmē. Viņas labākais draugs Pandijs Ķepa vienmēr ir viņai blakus un ir gatavs jebkādam piedzīvojumam ar kādu kārumu un smaidu. Pievienojieties viņiem un pārējiem Gabijas kaķiem jautros piedzīvojumos! Rotaļājaties, veicat rokdarbus, dejojiet un katru dienu atklājiet jaunas lietas!

programme.title: Oktonauti
programme.desc: Oktonauti ir astoņu drosmīgu dzīvnieku komanda, kas dodas pretī zemūdens dziļumiem, lai bezbailīgi stātos pretī briesmām, iegūtu jaunus draugus un atklātu paslēptos jūras dzīļu dārgumus dažādās ekspedīcijās. Varonīgais oktonautu komandas kapteinis ir polārlācis Bārnakls. Viņš ir savādnieks, kurš mīl vadīt komandu, vienmēr pirmais dosies palīdzēt, bet brīvajā laikā viņam patīk spēlēt mūziku vai nodoties sapņainām pārdomām. Kaķis Kvazī ir negantnieks ar noslēpumainu pirāta pagātni. Viņš ceļo uz eksotiskām vietām, kuram patīk arī mierīga atpūta. Piemēram, zvilnēt vannā. Pingvīns Peso ir komandas mediķis. Viņš vislabāk zina, kā sasaitēt ievainojumus, līdzi sev nēsājot aptieciņu. Lai arī viņam ne sevišķi patīk briesmas, vajadzības gadījumā Peso dosies palīgā jebkuram oktonautam. Katras sērijas stāsts balstīts uz kādu zemūdens piedzīvojumu, atklājot dārgumu lādes, cīnoties ar haizivju baru vai glābjot kādu komandas biedru. Britu seriāla "Oktonauti" veidotāji ir kanādieši Vikija Vonga (Vicki Wong) un Maikls Mērfijs (Michael Murphy). Abi animatori darba procesā rūpīgi pētījuši zemūdens pasaules īpatnības, padarot animēto vidi pēc iespējas tuvinātu realitātei, taču nezaudējot noslēpuma un pasakainu piedzīvojumu auru. Seriāla veidošanā palīdzējusi arī jūras biologu komanda- speciālisti, kuri palīdzējuši tapt arī animācijas filmai "Meklējot Nemo".

programme.title: Uzmanību, gatavību, kosmosā!
programme.desc: Šons, kuram ir nerimstoša vēlme izzināt zinātnes faktus, un Sidnija, kurai patīk zinātniskā fantastika un iztēle, ir kaimiņi un labākie draugi. Viņi abi sadraudzējas ar Džetu Dzinējspēku, kurš tikko pārvācies dzīvot viņu ielā. Un viņa ģimene ir citplanētieši. Kopā viņi dodas lieliskos piedzīvojumos, pēta saules sistēmu, mācās par kosmosu un zinātni, bet allaž atgriežas laikā uz vakariņām.

Katras dienas beigās neizbēgami tiek iegūta kāda vērtīga atziņa par dzīvi.

programme.title: Oktonauti
programme.desc: Oktonauti ir astoņu drosmīgu dzīvnieku komanda, kas dodas pretī zemūdens dziļumiem, lai bezbailīgi stātos pretī briesmām, iegūtu jaunus draugus un atklātu paslēptos jūras dzīļu dārgumus dažādās ekspedīcijās. Varonīgais oktonautu komandas kapteinis ir polārlācis Bārnakls. Viņš ir savādnieks, kurš mīl vadīt komandu, vienmēr pirmais dosies palīdzēt, bet brīvajā laikā viņam patīk spēlēt mūziku vai nodoties sapņainām pārdomām. Kaķis Kvazī ir negantnieks ar noslēpumainu pirāta pagātni. Viņš ceļo uz eksotiskām vietām, kuram patīk arī mierīga atpūta. Piemēram, zvilnēt vannā. Pingvīns Peso ir komandas mediķis. Viņš vislabāk zina, kā sasaitēt ievainojumus, līdzi sev nēsājot aptieciņu. Lai arī viņam ne sevišķi patīk briesmas, vajadzības gadījumā Peso dosies palīgā jebkuram oktonautam. Katras sērijas stāsts balstīts uz kādu zemūdens piedzīvojumu, atklājot dārgumu lādes, cīnoties ar haizivju baru vai glābjot kādu komandas biedru. Britu seriāla "Oktonauti" veidotāji ir kanādieši Vikija Vonga (Vicki Wong) un Maikls Mērfijs (Michael Murphy). Abi animatori darba procesā rūpīgi pētījuši zemūdens pasaules īpatnības, padarot animēto vidi pēc iespējas tuvinātu realitātei, taču nezaudējot noslēpuma un pasakainu piedzīvojumu auru. Seriāla veidošanā palīdzējusi arī jūras biologu komanda- speciālisti, kuri palīdzējuši tapt arī animācijas filmai "Meklējot Nemo".

programme.title: Pollija Poketa
programme.desc: Kad 11 gadus vecā Pollija Poketa un viņas draugi izmanto "mazo spēku", nākas saskarties ar lieliem izaicinājumiem un vēl lielākiem piedzīvojumiem.

programme.title: Robopolicists Pollijs
programme.desc: Brūmstaunā, mazpilsētā ar varenu glābšanas komandu, allaž notiek negadījumi un nepatikšanas, piemēram, mašīna lietū noslīd no klints, kāda cita avarē, bērns tiek ieslēgts ugunsdzēsēju depo utt. Katrā sērijā glābšanas komanda kādu glābj.

programme.title: Runājošais Toms: Varoņi pēkšņi superīgi
programme.desc: Runājošais Toms un viņa draugi — Andžela, Bens un Henks atklāj noslēpumainu ierīci, kas viņiem piešķir pārsteidzošas spējas un padara viņus par ""Pēkšņi superīgiem""! Nu viņiem piemīt satriecošas spējas un dažādi noderīgi riki, un tie ir gatavi aizsargāt savu pilsētu no visa veida nelaimēm un neliešiem. Papildu palīdzību sniegs uzticamie draugi Runājošā Beka un Runājošā Džindžera. Diemžēl izrādās, ka supervaroņu dzīvei nav instrukcijas, un viņiem kopā būs jāatklāj savas patiesās spējas un jāglābj pasaule!

programme.title: Gabijas leļļu namiņš
programme.desc: Ar nelielu maģiju un ikdienas Leļļu mājas piegādi izpētiet fantastisko Leļļu māju ar Gabiju un visiem viņas kaķu draugiem. Gabija ir pozitīva un apņēmīga 11 gadus veca meitene, kura pieņem trūkumus un pārvērš kļūdas izaugsmē. Viņas labākais draugs Pandijs Ķepa vienmēr ir viņai blakus un ir gatavs jebkādam piedzīvojumam ar kādu kārumu un smaidu. Pievienojieties viņiem un pārējiem Gabijas kaķiem jautros piedzīvojumos! Rotaļājaties, veicat rokdarbus, dejojiet un katru dienu atklājiet jaunas lietas!

programme.title: Princese bruņiniece Nella
programme.desc: Britu un amerikāņu animācijas seriālā jautrā un bezbailīgā princese Nella vajadzības brīdī kļūst par bruņinieci, lai sargātu savu karaļvalsti. Viņas lielākais dārgums ir draugi: vienradze Trinketa, zirgs Klods un sers Garets. Kopā viņi jautri pavada laiku, atšķetina noslēpumus un pārvar grūtības, kas gadās pat vislaimīgākajā karaļvalstī.

programme.title: Matchbox piedzīvojumi
programme.desc: Gatavojieties braukt savā piedzīvojumā un pievienoties Meisonam Džeimsam un viņa māsai Keilai, kad viņi ar Matchbox automašīnām dodas episkās misijās un pievar neticamus izaicinājumus! Skatieties, kā rotaļu istaba pārvēršas par izvirdošu vulkānu, svelmējošu tuksnesi un pat mitrājiem— kur vien iztēle jūs varētu aizvest!

programme.title: Džonijs Džetbojs
programme.desc: Džonijs Džonss ir jaunākais slepenās supervaroņu Džonsu ģimenes loceklis. Viņi zināmi arī kā Reaktīvā Flote. Arī viņiem reizēm rodas nesaskaņas, taču, kad viņi sadarbojas, nekas tos nespēj apturēt.
